tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Geometric convergence implies Gromov--Hausdorff convergence] ↗ def:geometric-limit ↗ def:gromov-hausdorff-convergence-unbounded

Let $(M_n,g_n,x_n)$ be a sequence of based Riemannian manifolds converging geometrically to $(M_\infty ,g_\infty ,x_\infty )$. Then the sequence also converges in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense to the same limit. \end{example}
